page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running under the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 16 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not feature any local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the weak to poor categories. However, the 16 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance across several workloads, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and software compilation with Clang. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks consistently register in the average tier, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

This instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its 16 dedicated cores, such as static web serving, Redis database operations, and multi-threaded decompression, all of which perform at average levels. It is less suitable for single-threaded tasks or memory-intensive applications due to its lower single-core performance and 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge offers a balanced option for legacy multi-threaded compute workloads that do not require high-speed local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
